nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What is the main consequence of urban expansion on kangaroos mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: The main consequence is increased human-kangaroo conflict, particularly vehicle-kangaroo interactions, which contribute to mortality in these landscapes.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife corridor conservation|Road ecology measures_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How does proximity to roads affect limb length in amphibians based on the findings from the study?
nodes.answer: Proximity to roads exerts selection pressure resulting in shorter hind limbs in Lissotriton helveticus individuals observed near dense road networks, possibly due to the counter-selection of more mobile individuals with longer limbs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife corridor conservation|Road ecology measures_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How are the Galapagos Yellow Warbler populations affected by human activity?
nodes.answer: The Galapagos Yellow Warbler is one of the most impacted species by roadkill.
